name: [Portal] Account settings screen, incl. migrated API-access section (UI)
description:
**Why?**
Consolidates contact/company/language/header settings (`005-account-surfaces.md`) with the OAuth/API-access fields that today live on a separate merchant-admin page (API Partner → "Access to API" tab).

**What?**
Build the single Account settings page per Figma ([node 41:335](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=41-335)).

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] Contact, access (email verify, password change, 2FA toggle), and company/billing sections render and save per `005-account-surfaces.md`
- [ ] **API-access section**: OAuth Client ID + masked secret (reveal last 5 chars / renew), OAuth server URLs — wired to the existing `ApiPartner::regenerateOAuthClientSecret()` (`cms/packages/Connectors/Model/ApiPartner.php:397`), replacing today's separate `ApiPartnerController::adminOauthAction` (`admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php:139`) / `Oauth.tpl` tab — no new OAuth logic
- [ ] Language/date/time-format selectors persist across CZ/SK/HU/EN
- [ ] Portal header color picker persists and applies to portal chrome
- [ ] `make fe-test` covers all sections

**Resources**

- Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=41-335&m=dev
- Backend: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/005-account-surfaces.md`, `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/006-i18n-emails.md`
- Existing API-access code being migrated: `admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php:139`, `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ApiPartner/Oauth.tpl`, `cms/packages/Connectors/Model/ApiPartner.php:397`
